speaker: Apollo
text: Greetings, explorer. I'm Apollo, your personal AI research assistant. I'll be accompanying you throughout your expedition on Mars. Let's begin by speaking with the local farmers. As you know, Earth is running out of resources, and we are humanity's only lifeline to find a solution. Fortunately, the inhabitants of Mars have developed some truly fascinating ways to survive here. Our first destination is Gale Crater, home to an extraordinary agricultural civilization. Against all odds, they've discovered how to grow thriving crops in the Martian environment. Your mission is to study their agricultural methods, collect soil samples, and transmit your findings to mission control. Don't worry about the language barrier. I'll handle all the translating. After all, what would you do without me? [chuckles] Speak with the alien farmers.
